brief.headline: Push for ₹250/kg laminate price (our best alternative rate) to save ₹22718 annually — you're paying 54% more than you should.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/kg on the laminate SKU, down from today's ₹385/kg.
priceAsk.target: ₹250/kg — that's what we pay Silk Polypack, and it sits at the top of the fair market band (₹205–305/kg typical ₹250/kg)
priceAsk.basis: Right now we overpay by 54% (gap ₹135/kg). The open market for pharma/ORS sachet laminate asks ₹205–305/kg typical ₹250/kg, so ₹250 is market-fair. Closing this gap saves us ₹22718 a year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 30 days instead of 60, in return for part of the price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days earlier frees up ₹5325 of our cash, so trade some of that for a better price — their debt is high (1.25x their own money) so faster payment is valuable to them.

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is huge (₹16492.00 Cr revenue) and we're tiny (₹64788 spend = 0.00% of their sales), so on our own we have almost no pull. They're growing fast (35.5% a year) and hungry for volume, which helps. They owe a lot — debt is 1.25x their equity (₹10152.31 Cr total) — so cash matters to them and faster payment is worth something. Push the price hard by naming Silk Polypack and the alternates, and offer the 30-day terms as a sweetener only if they move meaningfully toward ₹250/kg.

evidence.point: We pay UFLEX ₹385/kg while Silk Polypack charges ₹250/kg for the same laminate
Open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg — so ₹250 is the top of the fair band
evidence.figure: marketAsk askBand ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg, verdict MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)

evidence.point: We're microscopic to them — our ₹64788 is 0.00% of their ₹16492.00 Cr revenue
They're growing sales by 35.5% a year, so they want new orders
They carry heavy debt — 1.25x their own cash, ₹10152.31 Cr total — so they value faster payment

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already supplies FDC in small volume — proven and scalable second source for laminate sachets (₹2755.75 Cr revenue, health C 58/100).

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of global Constantia group, specialises in pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source option (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health D 31/100).

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global Amcor, known for high-end pharma laminates — premium but very reliable alternate.

risks: We're 0.00% of their business, so alone we have no leverage — bundle more SKUs or a longer commitment to get their attention.
Their debt is high (1.25x equity) — a small risk to supply continuity if cash gets tight; keep Huhtamaki or Constantia Parikh warm as a backup.
If we push too hard without volume to offer, they may ignore us — lead with the Silk Polypack benchmark and the market ask, and be ready to walk to an alternate for trial orders.
Paying 30 days early costs us ₹5325 in cash — only trade it for a real price cut, not a token gesture.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to keep growing with you, but right now we're paying ₹385/kg when the same laminate costs us ₹250 elsewhere and the market asks ₹205–305 — let's close that gap so we can commit more volume to you.
